checks.name: independent published healthy-CGM reference encoded
checks.note: The raw public Jaeb archive is optional and not bundled; the paper-level aggregate metrics are external human data.

checks.name: likelihood-weighted posterior virtual patients
checks.note: Uses bounded priors, Gaussian target likelihoods and explicit model-discrepancy variance; not clinical patient inference.

checks.name: OOD PPO remains finite and improves over no-op
checks.note: PPO underperforms the heuristic OOD; this is retained as a limitation rather than tuned away.

checks.name: no individual-level external human data bundled
checks.note: External human data are opt-in downloads; only source metadata/reference summaries ship with the release.

ood_policy.interpretation: The v0.7 PPO generalizes above no-op but not above the hand-coded heuristic under the expanded OOD parameter box.

posterior.interpretation: The literature-centered likelihood concentrates the bounded engineering prior, but the result is not a measured population posterior.

reference.citation: Shah VN et al. J Clin Endocrinol Metab. 2019;104(10):4356-4364. PMID:31127824

external_cgm.interpretation: Published independent human CGM aggregates are now encoded; raw individual-level comparison is available locally after opt-in download.

credibility_classification.calculation_verification: strong reduced-order invariants/timestep regression inherited from v0.6-v0.7
credibility_classification.parameter_uncertainty: bounded prior + LHS + likelihood-weighted posterior mechanics implemented
credibility_classification.external_human_data: first independent aggregate CGM reference integrated; raw public dataset adapter added
credibility_classification.model_form_uncertainty: represented only as target-level discrepancy SD in posterior; not yet a dynamic discrepancy process
credibility_classification.rl_generalization: in-distribution positive; OOD limited and below heuristic

known_missing_or_unvalidated: raw Jaeb CGM comparison has to be run locally because the release environment cannot fetch the external archive
